assumptions.choice: 1% of current broker equity is risked per trade.
assumptions.reason: The specification gives a 1-2% example but no exact percentage.

assumptions.choice: ORB breaches and re-entries are evaluated using candle Close; market bracket entry is submitted on the re-entry candle and executes on the next candle.
assumptions.reason: The specification does not identify an OHLC field for the crossing condition and explicitly requires entry on the next candle.

assumptions.choice: A native stop order is placed at the relevant ORB boundary and a native limit order is placed at the ORB midpoint.
assumptions.reason: This implements exit when the price reaches the stated levels using available OHLC execution semantics.

assumptions.choice: The stated midpoint take-profit and stated ORB-boundary stop are used as controlling exit levels.
assumptions.reason: For a re-entry price, a fixed midpoint target and fixed ORB stop do not generally produce an exact 1:2 reward-to-risk ratio; changing either level or filtering entries would contradict the explicit level rules.

assumptions.choice: New York regular-session open is treated as 09:30 EDT and close as 16:00 EDT; with the supplied aware timestamps normalized by Backtrader, this is 13:30-20:00 UTC.
assumptions.reason: All supplied dates are during U.S. daylight saving time, and no timezone-conversion import is permitted.

assumptions.choice: Open positions are flattened at the 16:00 New York regular-session close.
assumptions.reason: The specification requires all trades closed by the end of the trading day but does not define a different daily cutoff.
